JOINT CONFERENCE COMMITTEE REPORT

We, the conferees, appointed by the respective bodies to consider and report upon the disagreeing vote on Senate Bill No. 81, report as follows:

We recommend that the House Amendment in the Nature of a Substitute (26109169D) be accepted with the following amendment to resolve the matter under disagreement:

1. Line 23, House Substitute, after the

strike

corresponding state statute or local ordinance

insert

incorporated state statute, local ordinance, or federal statute or regulation

Respectfully submitted,

Senator Scott A. Surovell (signed)

Senator Elizabeth B. Bennett-Parker (signed)

Senator JD "Danny" Diggs (signed)

Conferees on the part of the Senate

Delegate Paul E. Krizek (signed)

Delegate Jackie H. Glass (signed)

Delegate Mitchell Cornett (signed)

Conferees on the part of the House
